neighbour_note: the bytes after the FDE range (0x5d51d05..0x5d51d10) are int3 padding, not a landing-pad block; the next FDE (0x5d51d10..0x5d51d53) is a separate routine, not part of this one
never_read_or_written: the contents of any released member beyond its first qword (the vtable pointer, read only to load slot +0x8)
the record itself is never written and never freed
order: release of the +0x20 member (only when non-null, indirect call through vtable slot +0x8)
release of each non-null vector element in order (same indirect call; null slots skipped)
operator delete of the vector buffer (only when the +0x08 begin pointer is non-null, size = +0x18 capacity end minus begin, in bytes)
release of the +0x00 head member (only when non-null, via an indirect tail jump through vtable slot +0x8, so it returns directly to the caller)

reads.role: head member pointer; released last via an indirect tail jump when non-null
vector begin pointer; the buffer deleted after the element loop when non-null
vector end pointer; the element loop runs from begin to end
vector capacity-end pointer; delete size is capacity end minus begin, in bytes
single member pointer; released first when non-null
